# Is my email list safe to import?

> Free email list CSV checker for Mailchimp, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Brevo and Constant Contact imports: finds invalid and duplicate emails, domain typos like gmial.com, role and disposable addresses, Excel damage and wrong column names, with line numbers, and downloads a safe-fixes copy plus a rejected-rows file.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
